Apple's gross profit (reported as "gross margin") for fiscal Q4 2024, the quarter ended September 28, 2024, was about **$43.88 billion**. This is from memory of the reported figures, not checked against the filing.

- Net sales were $94.93 billion.
- Cost of sales was $51.05 billion.
- Gross profit is therefore $94.93B − $51.05B = $43.88B, a gross margin of about 46.2%.
